name: notion-page-deleted-to-zapier-tables

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook for Notion INTEGRATION-WEBHOOK events (page.deleted / page.undeleted), the `{ type, entity: { id }, data: { parent: { data_source_id } } }` shape. `webhook_url` is what the Notion webhook subscription must POST to; `trigger_url` is Zapier-internal.

notion.note: No Notion connection is bound: every branch is a Zapier Tables call. `setup_calls_data_source` is '[Ernest] Internal Setup Calls DB'. Contacts deletions are deliberately skipped here — contact-emails-to-zapier-table owns them (merge hand-over vs genuine delete).

tables.01JM8PH8YM93A482M8BFZ6WKW6: [Table] Company IDs — rows DELETED on company page deletion (f14 Notion Page ID is the key). A page.undeleted for a company is forwarded to notion-companies-to-zapier-table's catch URL so the mirror re-creates the row.
tables.01JZCVG73MBWWB0357CEPS4903: [Table] Meeting Note IDs — rows FLAGGED Archived (f7), never deleted, on meeting-note deletion (f2 Page ID is the key); un-flagged on page.undeleted. Same never-delete rule as gcal-event-updated-to-meeting-note.
tables.01KEE5CTAZMJ8CR2608S2QWT5H: [Table] Notion Setup Session Mapping — rows DELETED on setup-call page deletion (f2 Page ID is the key).

replaces_classic_zap: Delete Contact, Company or Meeting Note Page from Zapier Table (paths B/C/D — path A, Contacts, was already retired into contact-emails-to-zapier-table on 2026-07-26)

cutover.notion_webhook_repointed: PENDING — repoint the Notion integration-webhook subscription that currently posts page.deleted events to the classic Zap's catch URL at this workflow's webhook_url. Notion answers the new URL with a verification ping; the token is readable in that skipped run's input.
cutover.classic_zap_disabled: PENDING — turn the classic Zap off in the Zapier UI once repointed. Not machine-verifiable: classic Zaps are exposed by neither the SDK CLI nor the MCP connector.
cutover.status: durable live and verified; Notion-side repointing outstanding

description: Notion page.deleted webhook -> remove/flag the page's row in the matching Zapier Table (Companies deleted, Meeting Notes flagged Archived, Setup Sessions deleted). Contacts deletions are owned by contact-emails-to-zapier-table.
